name: What are the pros and cons of owning a canal-front versus a direct oceanfront property?

mainEntity.name: What are the pros and cons of owning a canal-front versus a direct oceanfront property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Canal-front properties often provide protected dockage for boats and easier access to the Intracoastal Waterway and ocean, typically at a lower price point than direct oceanfront. Oceanfront properties offer immediate beach access and unobstructed views but may come with higher insurance costs and greater exposure to elements. Your decision depends on your priority: protected boating or direct beach living.
acceptedAnswer.description: Canal-front offers protected boat access and often lower costs. Oceanfront provides direct beach access and views but may have higher expenses.
